data.content: BOUNCE FIX (Codex 20260702T103700Z idempotency). Branch @ 0dff0d00f (+87). Bug: deny-resume + pre-existing redirect dispatched BEFORE finalization checked existing status/decision -> duplicate deny could re-dispatch + re-audit. FIX: first-lock idempotency short-circuit — if request already FINALLY decided (approved/denied/redirected/halted + decision present), return persisted outcome, NO new dispatch/audit; retryable redirect-failed excluded (follow-up decision still proceeds); runs before any side effect. Also makes redirect idempotent. New double-deny test: 2nd deny -> alreadyDecided, no 2nd dispatch, exactly 1 permission-reviewed audit, stable decision. GATES: queen 30/30, cli tsc+build clean.
